description.value: Vehicle-accessible BC Parks campground on Galiano Island in the southern Gulf Islands, set among shell-midden beaches, tidal lagoons, old forest, and 130+ bird species; reaching it requires a BC Ferries crossing to Sturdies Bay followed by a 10 km signed ride on Montague Park Road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record is for the vehicle campground section of Montague Harbour Marine Park, a BC Provincial Park on Galiano Island; the BC Parks website confirms it is active with vehicle-accessible and walk-in campsites. OSM infrastructure tags (drinking_water=yes, shower=no, power_supply=no, toilets=yes) provide primary facility data since the website content does not itemise site-level amenities. The BC Parks frontcountry camping page explicitly confirms reservations are accepted via camping.bcparks.ca.
concerns: OSM phone +1-877-559-2115 is for operator K2 Park Services Ltd. The BC Parks website lists 1-800-689-9025 as the general contact; the K2 number could not be verified from the fetched website content.
Address field is empty in OSM. The park is on Montague Park Road, Galiano Island, but a full civic address is unconfirmed.
OSM name includes '- Vehicle' suffix, suggesting a companion walk-in campground record may exist — check for duplicate OSM entries for this park.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Provincial Park campground on Galiano Island directly relevant to Gulf Islands cycle touring routes; sufficient evidence to list.
